verdict.rationale: Codex runs commands inside a sandbox, with rules controlling which commands may run outside it (docs-95). Administrators can restrict network access (docs-88), and Codex can run tests (docs-27, docs-39), so some agent work is isolated. However, the evidence is only a single thin mention of the sandbox and never describes a test environment kept separate from production data. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox scope and data isolation, any staging or test-environment capability separate from production systems or data, details on how test runs avoid touching live data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
